tools.name: check_caption
tools.description: Counts a post's text the way Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and X count it, against each platform's limits: characters, X's weighted 280 (emoji 2, links 23), TikTok's UTF-16 2,200, YouTube's 100-character title and 5,000-byte description, Instagram's 5 hashtags and 20 mentions. Retur

tools.name: check_video
tools.description: Says whether a video will post on each platform (as a Reel, Short or video, and as an Instagram or Facebook Story), from its technical facts: size in bytes, length, width and height, frame rate, video and audio codec, sample rate, container, HDR and whether the index is at the front. Returns a verdi

tools.name: get_platform_specs
tools.description: Returns the limits for posting to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and X (or one of them): text length and how it's counted, hashtags, video length, file size, shape, codecs, frame rate, Stories, photos per post and posts per day, with the date they were checked.

tools.name: get_image_sizes
tools.description: Returns recommended image sizes per platform (posts, Stories, covers, banners, thumbnails, profile pictures) with each size's source.

tools.name: get_safe_zones
tools.description: Returns the margins to keep clear on a 1080×1920 vertical video for Instagram and Facebook Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, where each app's buttons and captions sit, with sources.

tools.name: build_utm_links
tools.description: Adds utm_source, utm_medium (social by default), utm_campaign and optionally utm_content and utm_term to a link: one link per platform, or one for a source you name.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_caption, check_video, get_platform_specs, get_image_sizes · Private data: get_platform_specs · Public sink: check_caption, check_video, get_platform_specs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_caption, check_video, get_platform_specs, get_image_sizes · Private data: get_platform_specs · Public sink: check_caption, check_video, get_platform_specs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
